The '''Mark XI Detection Droid''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that was used by the forces of the [[Specialists]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit. Mark XI Detection Droids were deployed under the control of [[QO-99]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
